dispute.description: My driver arrived at the Bugis Junction pickup point at 10:00. I messaged at 10:01 that I was coming to the pickup bay, but the driver cancelled at 10:04 and I was charged $5.00 for a no-show. The app's five-minute free wait had not ended, and the eight-minute no-show threshold had not been reached. Please reverse the charge.
dispute.driver_statement: I arrived at 10:00 and sent a message. The rider said they were coming, but I had not seen them by 10:04, so I cancelled.

content.content: I am at the booked pickup bay.
I am coming to the pickup bay. Please wait.
I cannot see you yet. I am going to cancel.
Trip cancelled by driver. Reason: rider_no_show. Cancellation fee of $5.00 applied.

content.details: Rider R-7824 booked TRIP-2026-09946 from Bugis Junction pickup bay to Suntec City. Scheduled pickup 10:00.
GPS recorded the driver at the booked pickup coordinates.
Five-minute free wait ends at 10:05. Eight-minute no-show threshold ends at 10:08.
Driver cancelled the trip with reason rider_no_show.
$5.00 no-show cancellation fee charged to the rider.

evidence.content: No rider location was recorded for this Trip, so the rider's position is unknown.

policy_clauses.text: Check that the pickup point, destination, ride option and passenger details in the booking are accurate. For a private hire car, book through the app and use the stated pickup and drop-off point rather than a taxi stand. Tell the driver about a material change through the app where possible.

Use the in-app trip status and messages to coordinate at pickup. If a trip is cancelled or a no-show fee appears, keep the trip and payment details and ask the platform to review the specific charge. This draft sets no fixed waiting period or fee.

Review the fare and payment information shown for the booking and the receipt after the trip. Raise an unexpected, duplicate or missing charge through the platform with the trip reference and available receipt details.
Use trip communications and report tools for ride-related matters. Share only information needed to describe the issue, and distinguish what you observed from what you are unsure about.

Follow the in-app pickup details, use available trip communication to coordinate, and record the trip status accurately. Do not represent an arrival, cancellation or no-show as verified solely from a report claim.

Use the booking and platform payment flow for trip charges, and ensure the fare is shown to the commuter upfront in the app. Do not add an undisclosed off-platform trip charge; retain relevant trip and receipt records for review.
Use passenger information only as needed to provide and support the booked trip. Keep reports factual, distinguish direct observations from assumptions, and use the platform’s support channel.
Keep booking, trip status and support information accurate. Do not use another person’s platform account or misstate trip activity.

precedents.case_summary: The driver arrived on time and cancelled before the free wait had ended, after the rider replied that they were on their way.

ruling.policy_fit_reason: The recorded facts matched the clauses cited.
ruling.reasoning_summary: The wait recorded in the fare evidence was shorter than the free wait, so the conditions for a no-show charge were not met. Not knowing where the rider was does not shorten the wait.

precedents.case_summary: The rider said they were coming but never reached the pickup point. The driver stayed through the no-show threshold, messaged and called, and the rider gave no position.

ruling.policy_fit_reason: The recorded facts matched the clauses cited.
ruling.reasoning_summary: A reply that they were on the way did not stop the clock. The driver waited the full threshold and kept trying to make contact, so the fee stands.

precedents.case_summary: The driver reached the pickup point on time, waited past the free wait and the no-show threshold, and tried to reach the rider by message and call. The rider's position is unknown.

ruling.policy_fit_reason: The recorded facts matched the clauses cited.
ruling.reasoning_summary: The driver met every wait threshold in the fare evidence and tried to make contact. The rider's claim of waiting elsewhere was unproven, so the fee stands.

submissions.author: rider_advocate
submissions.claim_restated: The driver arrived at Bugis Junction at 10:00 and cancelled at 10:04 after a four-minute wait. The rider replied at 10:01 that they were coming to the pickup bay. The charged no-show fee should be reversed.

counter_arguments.argument: The driver was at the booked bay and had not seen the rider by 10:04.
counter_arguments.response: GPS supports the driver's presence for four minutes, but the fare evidence shows neither the five-minute free wait nor the eight-minute no-show threshold had elapsed. Rider location is unavailable; it does not change those recorded timings.

submissions.requested_outcome: Reverse the no-show cancellation fee recorded in the fare evidence.

submissions.author: driver_advocate
submissions.claim_restated: The driver arrived at the booked Bugis Junction pickup bay at 10:00, messaged the rider, and cancelled at 10:04 after a four-minute wait because they could not see the rider.

counter_arguments.argument: The rider says the cancellation occurred before the trip's waiting thresholds.
counter_arguments.response: The fare evidence confirms a four-minute wait against a five-minute free wait and eight-minute no-show threshold. The rider replied at 10:01. GPS supports arrival and presence, but these records do not support retaining the no-show fee.

submissions.requested_outcome: Recognise the recorded arrival and contact attempt, while accepting reversal of the prematurely applied no-show fee.

calculation.formula: no-show fee charged, reversed in full

argument_assessments.argument: The driver arrived at the booked Bugis Junction pickup bay at 10:00, messaged the rider, and cancelled at 10:04 after a four-minute wait because they could not see the rider.

ruling.policy_fit_reason: R-02 and D-02 support reviewing pickup coordination and accurate trip status; R-03 and D-03 support charge review. The waiting thresholds come from the trip's fare evidence, not the shared policy text, and were not reached.
ruling.reasoning_summary: The four-minute wait ended before the trip's five-minute free wait and eight-minute no-show threshold. The rider replied that they were coming; their physical location is unknown. Arrival and contact do not justify the premature no-show charge. Uphold the claim and reverse the cancellation fee recorded in the fare evidence. Departs from precedent: PREC-NS-05 and PREC-NS-01 rejected the claim because the no-show threshold had been reached. Here only four minutes had passed, below both the free wait and the threshold.

[
  {
    "clause_id": "R-01",
    "category": "no_show_charge",
    "text": "Check that the pickup point, destination, ride option and passenger details in the booking are accurate. For a private hire car, book through the app and use the stated pickup and drop-off point rather than a taxi stand. Tell the driver about a material change through the app where possible.",
    "version": "waypoint-singapore-draft-2026-10"
  },
  {
    "clause_id": "R-02",
    "category": "no_show_charge",
    "text": "Use the in-app trip status and messages to coordinate at pickup. If a trip is cancelled or a no-show fee appears, keep the trip and payment details and ask the platform to review the specific charge. This draft sets no fixed waiting period or fee.",
    "version": "waypoint-singapore-draft-2026-10"
  },
  {
    "clause_id": "R-03",
    "category": "no_show_charge",
    "text": "Review the fare and payment information shown for the booking and the receipt after the trip. Raise an unexpected, duplicate or missing charge through the platform with the trip reference and available receipt details.",
    "version": "waypoint-singapore-draft-2026-10"
  },
  {
    "clause_id": "R-06",
    "category": "no_show_charge",
    "text": "Use trip communications and report tools for ride-related matters. Share only information needed to describe the issue, and distinguish what you observed from what you are unsure about.",
    "version": "waypoint-singapore-draft-2026-10"
  },
  {
    "clause_id": "D-02",
    "category": "no_show_charge",
    "text": "Follow the in-app pickup details, use available trip communication to coordinate, and record the trip status accurately. Do not represent an arrival, cancellation or no-show as verified solely from a report claim.",
    "version": "waypoint-singapore-draft-2026-10"
  },
  {
    "clause_id": "D-03",
    "category": "no_show_charge",
    "text": "Use the booking and platform payment flow for trip charges, and ensure the fare is shown to the commuter upfront in the app. Do not add an undisclosed off-platform trip charge; retain relevant trip and receipt records for review.",
    "version": "waypoint-singapore-draft-2026-10"
  },
  {
    "clause_id": "D-06",
    "category": "no_show_charge",

  },
  {
    "clause_id": "D-09",
    "category": "no_show_charge",
    "text": "Keep booking, trip status and support information accurate. Do not use another person\u2019s platform account or misstate trip activity.",
    "version": "waypoint-singapore-draft-2026-10"
  }
]

The policy sets no wait time or fee: use the thresholds in the fare evidence, counted from the driver's arrival. Cite only Evidence Item IDs you were given. Do not calculate amounts or state a confidence. Reply with one JSON object only.
